FN-GP0A2C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 178
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Jerry Starnes
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/10/2023
Senate Bill 178 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama G.I. Dependents
Scholarship Program, paid from the by Education Trust Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent on
the cost of education benefits provided to spouses of veterans eligible pursuant to this bill. Under
current law, these benefits are limited to: (1) the Department of Defense Tuition Assistance Cap of $250
per credit hour, currently; (2) the $1,000 per semester cap on books and fees; and (3) after first applying
for other federal, state institutional, and 3rd party scholarships awarded for the academic year. For fiscal
year 2022, the average annual amount of educational benefits paid per student was approximately
$5,700.

FN-GP0A2C-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 315
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Jerry Starnes
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/30/2023
House Bill 315 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the obligations of the
Alabama G.I. Dependents Scholarship Program, paid from the by Education Trust Fund, by an
undetermined amount dependent on the cost of education benefits provided to spouses of
veterans eligible pursuant to this bill. Under current law, these benefits are limited to: (1) the
Department of Defense Tuition Assistance Cap of $250 per credit hour, currently; (2) the $1,000
per semester cap on books and fees; and (3) any balance remaining after first applying for other
federal, state institutional, and 3rd party scholarships awarded for the academic year. For fiscal
year 2022, the average annual amount of educational benefits paid per student was
approximately $5,700.
